Ltd. ...Appellant/Petitioner(s) Through: None Vs. Addl. District Magistrate Budgam and Ors. ...Respondent(s)
texts.arguments: Mr. Satinder Singh Kala, the learned Additional Advocate General submits that the Government has issued a notification dated 15th December, 2023, being S.O 616, in exercise of the power conferred under sub-section (3) of Section 70 of the Food Safety & Standards, Act 2006 read with Rule 3.2.1 of the Food Safety & Standards Rules, 2011 and accordingly, appointed the following Presiding Officers for Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Kashmir and Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Jammu. Jurisdiction Presiding Officer Kashmir Shri. Shujat Al Khan S/O Usman Ali Khan R/O Village Naloosa, Tehsil Boniyar Sub Division Uri, District Baramulla. Jammu Shri Ramesh Kumar Wattal S/O Lt. Shri Jagar Nath Wattal R/O House No. 69, Durga Nagar Enclave Sector,1 Jammu. Del Monte Foods Pvt. Ltd vs Addl. District Magistrate Budgam And ... on 20 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7981440/ 1 Mr. Satinder Singh Kala, the learned Additional Advocate General submits that in the light of the notification issued by the Government, this Court lacks inherent jurisdiction to adjudicate the instant writ petition any further and as such, the instant writ petition needs to be transferred to the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Kashmir, for adjudication. He further submits that the petitioner has to approach the said Tribunal by way of an appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety & Standards, Act 2006 against the order of the Adjudicating Officer, which is under challenge in the present writ petition.
